extract_video_features: extract video features from frames using a vision-language model and return segmented feature tensors
create_Image_Dataset: create a PyTorch Dataset that loads and transforms images from a list of file paths
read_json_config: read a JSON configuration file and return its contents as an OrderedDict
run_change_point_detection: run change-point detection on video frame features to segment the video into temporal segments
summarize_extract_video_features: summarize the extract_video_features function that loads frames, extracts features, segments via CPD, and returns tensors
